description.p: A store with no central server: publishers sign their releases with their own Nostr keys, the catalog is a feed of those signatures, and every artifact is pinned to the digest the publisher signed before a single byte installs. A GPU-rendered client renders that feed as a normal app store: search, app pages, release notes, a permissions viewer built from the real sandbox profile, reviews from the people you actually trust.

Apps install as ordinary flatpaks and keep updating through flatpak itself; Flathub's catalog appears alongside publisher channels as just another source. Orchard distributes itself the same way it distributes everyone else.
